items.en: Marco

items.zh: 小明：这是你们比赛的照片吗？
items.py: Xiǎomíng: Zhè shì nǐmen bǐsài de zhàopiàn ma?
items.en: Xiaoming: Is this a photo of your competition?

items.zh: 马可：是，这是我们比赛后照的。
items.py: Mǎkě: Shì, zhè shì wǒmen bǐsài hòu zhào de.
items.en: Marco: Yes, we took it after the competition.

items.zh: 小明：照得不错，你们都是一个年级的吗？
items.py: Xiǎomíng: Zhào de bùcuò, nǐmen dōu shì yī ge niánjí de ma?
items.en: Xiaoming: It's a nice shot. Are you all in the same grade?

items.zh: 马可：不是。那个又高又漂亮的女孩儿是二年级的。
items.py: Mǎkě: Bù shì. Nàge yòu gāo yòu piàoliang de nǚháir shì èr niánjí de.
items.en: Marco: No. That tall, pretty girl is in second year.

items.zh: 小明：旁边那个拿着书笑的人是谁？
items.py: Xiǎomíng: Pángbiān nàge názhe shū xiào de rén shì shéi?
items.en: Xiaoming: Who's the person next to her, smiling with a book in hand?

items.py: Mǎkě: Nà shì wǒ!
items.en: Marco: That's me!

items.en: always

items.py: huídá
items.en: to answer

items.py: zhàn

items.zh: 小丽：你觉得小红怎么样？
items.py: Xiǎolì: Nǐ juéde Xiǎohóng zěnmeyàng?
items.en: Xiaoli: What do you think of Xiaohong?

items.zh: 同学：她又聪明又热情，也很努力。
items.py: Tóngxué: Tā yòu cōngming yòu rèqíng, yě hěn nǔlì.
items.en: Classmate: She's both smart and warm, and very hard-working too.

items.zh: 小丽：我看她总是笑着回答老师的问题。
items.py: Xiǎolì: Wǒ kàn tā zǒngshì xiàozhe huídá lǎoshī de wèntí.
items.en: Xiaoli: I notice she always smiles when she answers the teacher's questions.

items.zh: 同学：她对每个人都笑，也常常对我笑。
items.py: Tóngxué: Tā duì měi ge rén dōu xiào, yě chángcháng duì wǒ xiào.
items.en: Classmate: She smiles at everyone, and she often smiles at me too.

items.zh: 小丽：你是不是喜欢她啊？
items.py: Xiǎolì: Nǐ shì bu shì xǐhuan tā a?
items.en: Xiaoli: Do you like her or something?

items.zh: 同学：喜欢她的人太多了，你看那些拿着鲜花站在门口的，都是等她的。
items.py: Tóngxué: Xǐhuan tā de rén tài duō le, nǐ kàn nàxiē názhe xiānhuā zhàn zài ménkǒu de, dōu shì děng tā de.
items.en: Classmate: Too many people like her. Look at those people standing at the door holding flowers: they're all waiting for her.

items.zh: 小刚：我有点儿饿了，我们进超市买点儿东西吧。
items.py: Xiǎogāng: Wǒ yǒudiǎnr è le, wǒmen jìn chāoshì mǎi diǎnr dōngxi ba.
items.en: Xiaogang: I'm a bit hungry. Let's go into the supermarket and buy something.

items.zh: 小丽：好啊，这家超市的蛋糕又便宜又好吃，一块只要2.99元。
items.py: Xiǎolì: Hǎo a, zhè jiā chāoshì de dàngāo yòu piányi yòu hǎochī, yī kuàir zhǐ yào èr diǎn jiǔ jiǔ yuán.
items.en: Xiaoli: Sure. The cake at this supermarket is cheap and tasty, only 2.99 yuan a slice.

items.zh: 小刚：我们买两块，回家吃着蛋糕看电视，怎么样？
items.py: Xiǎogāng: Wǒmen mǎi liǎng kuàir, huí jiā chīzhe dàngāo kàn diànshì, zěnmeyàng?
items.en: Xiaogang: Let's buy two slices and eat cake while watching TV at home. How about it?

items.zh: 小丽：好啊，我再去买一些喝的。
items.py: Xiǎolì: Hǎo a, wǒ zài qù mǎi yīxiē hē de.
items.en: Xiaoli: Great, I'll go and buy something to drink too.

items.zh: 小刚：喝着咖啡吃蛋糕，太好了！
items.py: Xiǎogāng: Hēzhe kāfēi chī dàngāo, tài hǎo le!
items.en: Xiaogang: Cake with coffee, perfect!

items.en: Li Xiaomei (name)

items.py: Jīnglǐ: Nín hǎo! Nín zhǎo shéi?
items.en: Manager: Hello! Who are you looking for?

items.zh: 客人：你们这儿是不是有一个又年轻又漂亮的服务员？
items.py: Kèrén: Nǐmen zhèr shì bu shì yǒu yī ge yòu niánqīng yòu piàoliang de fúwùyuán?
items.en: Customer: Is there a young, pretty waitress here?

items.zh: 经理：我们这儿年轻、漂亮的服务员有很多。
items.py: Jīnglǐ: Wǒmen zhèr niánqīng, piàoliang de fúwùyuán yǒu hěn duō.
items.en: Manager: We have lots of young, pretty waitresses here.

items.zh: 客人：她工作又认真又热情。
items.py: Kèrén: Tā gōngzuò yòu rènzhēn yòu rèqíng.
items.en: Customer: She works conscientiously and is very warm.

items.py: Jīnglǐ: Nín néng zài shuōshuo ma?
items.en: Manager: Could you tell me a bit more?

items.zh: 客人：她总是笑着跟客人说话。
items.py: Kèrén: Tā zǒngshì xiàozhe gēn kèrén shuō huà.
items.en: Customer: She always smiles when talking to customers.

items.zh: 经理：啊，我知道了，你说的是李小美吧？
items.py: Jīnglǐ: À, wǒ zhīdào le, nǐ shuō de shì Lǐ Xiǎoměi ba?
items.en: Manager: Ah, I know. You mean Li Xiaomei, right?
